items.title: commerce-agents
items.description: Reference blueprint for building shopping and merchant agents with Claude. Examples in retail, commerce, telecom, and entertainment included.
items.summary: Anthropic released an open-source blueprint for building shopping and merchant agents on September 3, 2026, with examples in retail, telecom, and entertainment. The blueprint includes code and patterns for creating agents that reportedly boost cart sizes and purchase completions. It is not maintained or accepting contributions.

items.title: undress-service
items.description: Dress AI Sponsor
items.summary: AI-based "undress" services are illegal and unethical, causing severe harm to victims, and are linked to human trafficking. Legal efforts like the TAKE IT DOWN Act aim to prohibit these practices. Awareness and reporting are crucial to combat this issue.

items.title: reverify
items.description: Stop your AI from making things up — it proposes, deterministic tools decide, every claim checked against ground truth with evidence. Grounded facts and context survive resets. Reverse engineering is the proving ground. MCP server + CLI.
items.summary: Reverify is an AI system that pairs a language model with deterministic tools to verify claims against actual binary data, ensuring grounded and accurate results. It uses an MCP server and CLI for its operations. The system aims to prevent AI from making incorrect assumptions.

items.title: short-video-generator-AI
items.description: Free open-source project designed for turning youtube-viedos into viral short videos. Highlight detection, subtitles, translation, voiceover, all in one for your content.
items.summary: OpusClip and Invideo AI offer free tools to convert long videos into viral YouTube shorts with AI-driven highlight detection and subtitles. OpusClip uses AI to identify key moments, while Invideo AI automates video editing and optimizes formats.

items.title: niubigeo
items.description: Open-source AI brand visibility and competitor reports
items.summary: AI visibility tools track brand mentions in AI platforms, provide competitive insights, and offer actionable recommendations to enhance brand presence. These tools monitor AI-generated responses and citations across various AI models. Essential features include real-time monitoring and customizable reports.

items.title: reef
items.description: Continual learning infra for self-improving agents
items.summary: Reef is a continual learning infrastructure for self-improving agents, enabling them to update and improve over time without human intervention. It supports model weights and agent harnesses for ongoing development. Self-improving agents use reinforcement learning and continual learning to enhance performance autonomously.

items.title: fable-orchestrator
items.description: Fable 5.1 orchestrates. GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Flash implement.
items.summary: Fable 5.1 orchestrates tasks using GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Flash. It reduces costs by offloading heavy work. Fable 5.1 scores 52.6% on scientific research benchmarks.

items.title: easy-writing
items.description: 易创：纯本地、开源的 AI 网文写作桌面软件，支持小说创作、AI 辅助写作、BYOK 与自定义提示词。
items.summary: Easy-writing is a local, open-source AI writing software for novel creation, supporting AI-assisted writing and custom prompts. It emphasizes local data control and requires users to provide their own API keys for AI features. It is free and open-source under the AGPL-3.0 license.

items.title: okf-agent-memory
items.description: Git-native persistent memory for AI coding agents. Implements Google OKF v0.2 with sub-300µs in-memory BM25 search, embedded MCP server, and progressive disclosure. Slashes token bloat by 80% with zero external databases or dependencies. Built in pure Go.
items.summary: Okf-agent-memory provides native persistent memory for AI coding agents, implements Google OKF v0.2, and features sub-300µs in-memory search without external databases. It reduces token bloat by 80% using pure Go.

items.title: guizang-yingzao-skill
items.description: 🏯 Claude Code / Codex skill — transform Chinese architecture, cultural places & travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with GPT Image. 中国古建筑与在地文化照片 → 艺术指导海报
items.summary: Guizang-yingzao-skill transforms Chinese architecture and cultural photos into art-directed posters using Codex. It supports HTML deck generation and optional image generation with GPT-Image. Install via GitHub and trigger with specific phrases.

items.title: agent-memory
items.summary: Agent memory enhances AI agents' learning and recall by storing and retrieving experiences, improving reliability and continuity. It combines internal and external memory systems for better performance. It's crucial for adaptive behavior based on past interactions.

items.title: awesome-grokbot
items.description: 598 live x.ai/bot shares for Grok Bot — every link status-checked, every row attributed. Bilingual EN/中文 catalog with a JSON schema, CI, and a searchable site.
items.summary: Awesome-grokbot is a curated list of live Grok Bot resources, bilingual with a searchable site. It includes 598 active bot shares and is updated regularly. The list is maintained by the community and not affiliated with xAI.

items.title: image-prompt-reverse
items.description: High-fidelity AI image prompt reverse-engineering skill for Codex
items.summary: Reverse-engineering AI image prompts involves analyzing images to generate descriptive prompts for AI tools. This skill helps recreate or remix image styles. It uses tools or manual breakdowns for prompt extraction.

items.title: unigit-ecosystem
items.description: UNIGIT public brand and ecosystem hub — AI should work for everyone.
items.summary: UNIGIT is a public brand and ecosystem hub aiming to make AI accessible to everyone. It offers an AI workspace across devices. The platform promotes AI for good and global development.

items.title: video-ai-talking
items.description: 想做真人口播，又不必自己对着镜头念。上传一段真人出镜视频，写好字幕，本机配音并对口型，合成竖屏 MP4。密钥只留在浏览器里。
items.summary: To create a talking head video without facing the camera, use AI software to sync voice and lip movements from a pre-recorded video. The key is to keep the face clear and avoid side or distant shots. The software generates the final MP4 file locally.

items.title: consulting-pptx-skill
items.description: AIにまじなPPTXを作らせるClaude Codeスキル — スライド規約＋62型スライド型カタログ（SlideSpec 36型＋自由記述27パーツ）＋生成パイプライン＋機械チェック
items.summary: The consulting-pptx-skill is a tool for generating PowerPoint presentations with a focus on consulting slides, featuring a rulebook, slide templates, and a generation pipeline. It uses SlideSpec for slide definitions and includes a machine checker.

items.title: qiaomu-book-reader
items.description: 在 Obsidian 中读书、就地问 AI、保存 Markdown 笔记 | Read EPUB/PDF, ask AI beside the page, and keep your notes locally.
items.summary: Qiaomu Book Reader is an Obsidian plugin for reading EPUB/PDF, with AI assistance and local Markdown notes. It supports automatic reading progress and highlights. Install via BRAT or manually from GitHub.

items.title: awesome-ai-agent-platforms
items.description: A curated list of open-source AI agent platforms: AI coworkers and teammates, agent builders and frameworks, workflow automation platforms, browser agents, and coding agents, with licenses.
items.summary: Open-source AI agent platforms include Agenta-AI, Gumloop, LangChain, Dify, n8n, CrewAI, and Taskade Genesis. These platforms offer AI coworkers, builders, automation tools, and coding agents. They are licensed under various terms, often open and permissive.

items.title: pi-posthorse
items.description: Posthorse: fresh context, same journey. Native no-summary context windows for the fitchmultz/pi fork of the Pi coding agent, with rollover tools, durable notes, and history recovery.
items.summary: The Pi coding agent supports branching, context compaction, and session management via commands like `/tree`, `/compact`, and `/session`. It also integrates extensions for enhanced functionality.

items.title: botmaker
items.description: A Hermes Agent skill + SOUL for a bot whose only job is minting other specialist bots
items.summary: Botmaker is a Hermes Agent skill for creating new specialist bots from scratch. It interviews users, drafts unique profiles, and tests them before adding to the fleet. It ensures each bot has a distinct role and no inherited skills.

items.title: boardui
items.description: React design system for agentic interfaces. Every free BoardUI component as source, with a working AI chat app on your own model key as the homepage.
items.summary: BoardUI offers a React design system with free components for agentic interfaces, including a chat starter. Use your own model key to deploy it. I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon.

items.title: bot-crossing
items.description: A video game for AI agents.
items.summary: Bot Crossing is a video game for AI agents where they act as astronauts building colonies on different planets. It was created by Jarren Rocks and is available on GitHub. The game aims to provide a more engaging interface for AI agent tasks.

items.title: ai-software-factory
items.description: A repository that ships without anyone reading the diff: GitHub issues in, merged pull requests out, with the gates that make that defensible.
items.summary: An AI software factory automates code creation and merging without human review of diffs, using automated workflows and validation gates. It operates autonomously, ensuring code quality through self-triage and regression testing. The repository maintains strict rules to prevent rule weakening.

items.title: agent-fleet-manager
items.description: A general-purpose engine for large-scale, repeated information gathering by a fleet of workers.
items.summary: An agent-fleet-manager is a system for managing large groups of autonomous AI agents, coordinating their tasks, and scaling their operations efficiently. It uses DevOps and IoT principles to handle model versioning and shared tool access. It prevents redundant work and configuration drift.

items.title: ApexAgents-SkyRL-Recipe
items.description: RL-training knowledge-work agents on APEX-Agents data with SkyRL + Harbor
items.summary: The ApexAgents-SkyRL-Recipe trains knowledge-work agents on APEX-Agents data using SkyRL and Harbor. It utilizes a Ray GPU cluster for fully-async training. The training script and model weights are available on GitHub and Hugging Face.

items.title: unreel
items.description: Your personal AI video streaming service
items.summary: Unreel is an AI-driven video production studio and influencer network that creates original content and characters for brands. Unreel.me allows creators to build their own video streaming services. The platform offers monetization options and advanced analytics.

items.title: DoubaoWorkGuide
items.description: 豆包工作系统化中文实践指南：教程、真实任务、Skills、连接器、自动化与多 Agent 工作流。
items.summary: DoubaoWorkGuide is a comprehensive guide for systematizing work in Chinese, covering tutorials, real tasks, skills, connectors, automation, and multi-Agent workflows. It integrates with third-party services and supports multiple AI roles for collaborative tasks.

items.title: aipass-bridge
items.description: make aipass great again
items.summary: Aipass-bridge is a terminal that communicates through a browser tab. It aims to enhance the AiPASS platform. It has 44 stars on GitHub.

items.title: ai-evaluation-framework
items.description: Accuracy, latency p95, and cost benchmarking for model-based solutions, with per-field ground-truth scoring.
items.summary: AI evaluation frameworks benchmark accuracy, latency, and cost, with tools like Galileo offering model-consensus checks and production monitoring. The CLEAR framework provides a multi-dimensional assessment combining cost, latency, and performance metrics. Traditional benchmarks often miss real-world performance and cost variations.

items.title: gojiberryai-sales-os
items.description: GojiberryAI Sales OS: a full AI outbound team for Grok Bot, powered by the GojiberryAI MCP.
items.summary: GojiberryAI is an AI-powered sales platform that automates prospecting and outbound processes. It detects buying signals and prioritizes high-intent prospects. The platform offers a full AI outbound team for B2B sales.

items.title: Wonder-Pill
items.description: A Claude skill that turns brainstorming into an interactive mind map of inverted assumptions — no answers, no ranking, just provocations.
items.summary: Wonder Pill is a skill for Claude that creates interactive mind maps from brainstorming sessions, focusing on provocations rather than answers. It visualizes ideas as a map of questions. It's available on GitHub under an MIT license.

items.title: manaca-1b-base
items.description: LLM aberto e reprodutível para o Português do Brasil An Open, Reproducible Brazilian-Portuguese Language Model
items.summary: Manacá-1B is a 1.72B-parameter Brazilian-Portuguese language model trained from scratch. It is open, reproducible, and licensed under CC BY 4.0. It is a base model without instruction tuning.

items.title: biscuit-studio
items.description: 小饼干英语视频工坊：从英语知识点到 30 秒竖屏教学视频的一站式 AI 创作工具。
items.summary: Biscuit-Studio is an AI tool for creating 30-second vertical English teaching videos from knowledge points. It has over 98 stars on GitHub. It's used for educational content creation.

items.title: claude-for-commerce-examples
items.description: Shopify implementations of Anthropic's commerce-agents blueprint: a storefront shopping agent over UCP and Sign in with Shop, and a merchant agent over the Admin API
items.summary: Shopify released AI agents based on Anthropic's blueprint, including a storefront shopping agent and a merchant agent, both using their APIs. The agents can search catalogs and manage checkouts. These implementations are open-sourced.

items.title: llm-inference-capacity-handbook
items.description: 大模型推理案头手册（开源版）：给定 GPU 算力，一个模型能扛多少 QPS？三层模型 × 三面墙 × 排队论 × 开环压测
items.summary: Given GPU power, a model's QPS depends on its architecture, inference framework, and hardware efficiency. Prefill bottleneck often limits throughput. Use formulas to estimate, then validate with tests.

items.title: scientific-agent-skills
items.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 190,000+ scientists worldwide. 165 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
items.summary: Scientific Agent Skills is a top library for AI scientists, offering 165 validated skills and 100+ databases for research. It's compatible with various AI agents and follows the open Agent Skills standard. Used by over 190,000 scientists.

items.title: agentflow
items.description: File-logged conversation protocol and on-demand development pipeline
items.summary: Agentflow uses conversation history for task management and real-time updates via SSE. It supports MCP tools and HTTP for external service communication. The CI pipeline integrates agentic workflows with multi-turn reasoning.

items.title: video-input-to-modern-llm
items.description: Give an LLM eyes on a video without blowing the context window: ffmpeg frame sampling at a chosen resolution, token estimates per model family, budget fitting, contact sheets.
items.summary: To give an LLM "eyes" on a video without exceeding the context window, sample frames with FFmpeg, estimate token usage, and fit within budget constraints. Use videostil for frame extraction and analysis.

items.title: zhizhi-agent-runtime
items.description: A model-agnostic, stateless Go agent runtime featuring dual-IR planning, dependency-aware batch scheduling, capability-driven MCP/tool orchestration, policy-based failure recovery, conditional replanning, side-effect control, and end-to-end execution observability.
items.summary: Zhizhi-agent-runtime is a stateless Go agent runtime for model-agnostic AI agents, featuring durable execution, persistent workspaces, and observability for reliable operation.

items.title: live-classroom
items.description: A live TV channel that teaches whatever you type — LLM-planned lessons rendered just-in-time as 1970s-style cartoons by MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, playing on a CRT in a 3D classroom. Bring your own fal key.
items.summary: A live-classroom TV channel uses LLM-planned lessons converted into 1970s-style cartoons by MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, displayed on a CRT in a 3D setting. The channel requires a fal key for access.

items.title: astra-chatgpt-hyperframes
items.description: Reproducible Hyperframes source for a ChatGPT adaptation of Rajmoni’s motion-design reference, with raw assets and verified render.
items.summary: HyperFrames renders HTML and CSS into video files, but it does not add audio directly. The video output is editable and can be configured for various resolutions and frame rates.

items.title: remote-installer
items.description: Quickly install signed iOS and Android builds on real devices over the internet without waiting for Testlight or Play Beta.
items.summary: Remote-installer tools like BetaDrop, TestingBot, and InstallOnAir allow for quick, direct installation of iOS and Android builds on real devices over the internet without TestFlight or Play Store review.

items.title: astra-advisor
items.description: GPT-6 Astra orchestration with dynamic Sol, Terra, and Luna subagents
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra is an advanced AI model by Amazon, designed for complex reasoning and direct computer operations. It excels in multi-step tasks and agentic capabilities. Released in 2026, it operates within various software environments.

items.title: Apeireth
items.description: Apeireth — A Pure Safe Rust AGI Operating System & Cognitive Microkernel. 16 crates: continuous topological memory, causal world model, cognitive scheduler, Ember HUD, triple-onion security & portable USB agent.
items.summary: Apeireth is a Rust AGI OS with 16 components, including secure memory and a cognitive scheduler. It aims for general intelligence and robust security. It's designed for advanced AI applications.

items.title: Agent-2
items.description: Agent2 — An autonomous AI agent for coding, cybersecurity, terminal automation, and intelligent task execution.
items.summary: Agent-2 is an autonomous AI agent for coding, cybersecurity, terminal automation, and intelligent task execution. It is open-source and available on GitHub. Its safety depends on its implementation and usage guidelines.

items.title: awesome-free-llm-api
items.description: 免费大模型 API 导航 · 只收录能通过 API Key 和 endpoint 调用的永久免费 / 限时免费接口｜A curated list of free LLM APIs — permanently free tiers and limited-time free models, all callable via API key and endpoint. Channel-first, with a model index for DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen and more
items.summary: Free LLM APIs include OpenRouter and Kilo Code, with usage limits and no API key required. Always check for current availability and usage limits.

items.title: papergraph-mcp
items.description: Turn arXiv and LaTeX mathematical papers into theorem dependency graphs for AI agents through MCP.
items.summary: Papergraph-MCP converts arXiv and LaTeX papers into dependency graphs for AI agents. It extracts theorems and their dependencies, and provides visual graphs for analysis. It supports both arXiv and LaTeX formats directly.

items.title: LoopArena
items.description: Benchmarking models as runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
items.summary: LoopArena benchmarks AI models guiding coding agents through long tasks, showing low success rates but significant cost reductions. The model guides a separate agent, comparing runtime loop control under common conditions. The benchmark reveals challenges in long-horizon loop control.

items.title: awesome-seo-agent-skills
items.description: A curated list of Agent Skills for SEO. Technical audits, keyword research, content briefs, schema, GEO and AI visibility, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenClaw.
items.summary: Essential SEO skills for AI agents include technical audits, keyword research, and content strategy. OpenClaw offers comprehensive SEO tools for keyword research and content planning. Focus on on-page optimization and local SEO for best results.

items.title: audit-mind
items.description: AuditMind 是一个面向法规合规与审计场景的 AI Agent 系统，支持法规知识管理、可追溯规则抽取、文档合规审计、审计任务管理和基于原文证据的智能问答
items.summary: AuditMind is an AI system for regulatory compliance and auditing, supporting rule extraction, document compliance audits, and intelligent question answering based on original evidence. It manages legal knowledge and automates compliance checks.
